ruling.note: The two unresolved pre-shoot items require one development dry run whose frame count is not specified in the request; it is additional to the frozen 603-frame holdout session.

cross_cutting_disqualifiers.fact: All 10,509 inventoried ARWs report ImageStabilization On.
The frozen session requires body SteadyShot OFF and lens OSS OFF.
The scored value must come from this new sealed HOLDOUT session; existing development captures only commission.

pre_shoot_items.reason: No metadata-only evidence establishes 1.30x reproduction, gap-free coverage, or 64 interior sites; the request explicitly requires image-data verification.
The new slide has no required fixed-focus G2 burst pairs or matched A/B ladders for G3 at the exact configuration.
Converter identity is closed by owner testimony.
